commit.message:
refactor(dm): classify Bloc errors via Reportable matrix (#4590) (#4597)

* refactor(dm): classify Bloc errors via Reportable matrix (#4590)

Audit pass over mobile/lib/blocs/dm/** classifying every existing
addError site against the Reportable decision matrix in
.claude/rules/error_handling.md. Every site decides NO (Network/IO,
API/domain) — none of the existing generic catches isolate an
invariant-only path, so no new Reportable wraps are introduced.
The pre-existing YES site at conversation_bloc.dart:233 (landed in
PR #4402) is the only DM-area Crashlytics surface and stays as-is.

Each NO site now carries a 1–3 line comment naming its matrix row,
following the precedent in other_profile_bloc.dart:165 and
my_profile_bloc.dart:183.

No behaviour change. No new files. No test changes — existing
isA<Exception>() / isA<ArgumentError>() assertions remain valid
because the runtime types passed into addError don't change.

* refactor(dm): surface signer + cast invariants via Reportable (#4590)

Address self-review of the initial classification sweep:

1. Narrow `_onMessageDeleted` (`conversation_bloc.dart:104`):
   ArgumentError stays raw (matrix-NO, recoverable); anything else
   (e.g. signer `StateError`) is matrix-YES → `Reportable`-wrapped.

2. Narrow `_load` (`conversation_mute_cubit.dart:100`): FormatException
   stays raw (matrix-NO, corrupted JSON); `cast<String>()` `TypeError`
   is matrix-YES → `Reportable`-wrapped per the matrix table.

3. Lift identifiers to `mobile/lib/blocs/dm/reportable_sites.dart` with
   `ConversationBlocReportableSites` (now 2 YES sites in that bloc, per
   the spec's 2+ sites rule). Existing `_onSelfWrapRecoveryRequested`
   inline string moves to the constants class.

4. Tighten remaining NO comments to the 2-line precedent established
   by `other_profile_bloc.dart:165` / `my_profile_bloc.dart:183`.

Tests:
- `conversation_bloc_test.dart`: new test asserts StateError from
  `deleteMessageForEveryone` becomes `Reportable<StateError>`.
- `conversation_mute_cubit_test.dart`: new test asserts TypeError
  from `cast<String>()` becomes `Reportable<TypeError>` via a
  capturing `BlocObserver` (the addError fires during construction).

* fix(dm): report unexpected conversation action throws

---------

commit.message:
fix(reporting): recover from Nostr client init race and surface errors inline (#4587)

* fix(reporting): recover from Nostr client init race and surface errors inline (#4586)

ContentReportingService.initialize() checked _nostrService.isInitialized
once at construction. If the Nostr client was still initializing (race
introduced by the session-readiness gate), _isInitialized stayed false
permanently, silently dropping all reports. reportContent() now re-checks
at call time so late-ready clients recover without re-construction.

Report dialog errors were shown via ScaffoldMessenger snackbars that
rendered behind the bottom sheet modal (useRootNavigator: true), making
failures invisible to the user. Errors now display inline within the
sheet.

Closes #4586

* fix(report): apply design system to ReportConfirmationDialog

Replace raw Material Icons with DivineIcon, raw TextStyle with
VineTheme font methods, add Semantics wrapper for accessibility,
and delete dead _createReportMetadata method.

* fix(reporting): harden inline error regression coverage

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
docs(error-handling): add per-layer failure contract and discoverability anchor (#4581)

* docs(error-handling): add per-layer failure contract and discoverability anchor

Lifts the cross-layer division of responsibility (Client throws typed
exceptions, Repository composes/translates, BLoC catches and classifies
via the Reportable matrix, UI reads status enum and never error strings)
into a single rule-file table. Formalises language already scattered
through state_management.md and architecture.md without changing
existing policy.

Adds a "Reporter port pattern" sub-section in the Reportable section
documenting the pure-Dart-package approach used by dm_repository
(PR #4402), so future package extractions have a canonical reference
instead of re-deriving the typedef shape.

Adds mobile/docs/ERROR_HANDLING.md as the discoverable entry point
with anchors into the rule file plus the four canonical example sites
(BLoC multi-site, service-layer, package reporter-port, "explicitly
NOT Reportable" inline comment). CONTRIBUTING.md gets one line linking
to the new doc.

Strengthens the PII contract for direct ReportableError implementers:
they must ship a unit test asserting toString() is free of npub/nsec
and email-shaped identifiers, because the marker bypasses the wrapper
sanitizer.

Refs #4336.

* docs(error-handling): tighten discoverability links

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
chore(deps): bump flutter_local_notifications v19 → v21 (#3642) (#4579)

* chore(deps): bump flutter_local_notifications v19 → v21

Closes #3642.

v20 converted all positional args on initialize() / show() to named.
v21 only bumps minimum versions, which were already met:
- Flutter 3.41.9 (v21 floor: 3.38.1)
- Dart 3.11.x (v21 floor: 3.10.0)
- iOS 16 (v21 floor: 13)
- macOS 13 (v21 floor: 10.15)
- Android minSdk 28 (v21 floor: 24)
- compileSdk 36

Touches 5 call sites across 2 files:
- main.dart: _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler's initialize() + show()
- notification_service.dart: _initializePlugin's initialize(),
  sendLocal()'s show(), _sendPlatformNotification()'s show()

IOSFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.requestPermissions(),
AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.requestNotificationsPermission(),
and resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<...>() are unchanged in v21
and require no edits.

No platform setup change required: iOS UIScene already wires the plugin
via GeneratedPluginRegistrant in didInitializeImplicitFlutterEngine,
and FlutterAppDelegate handles UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate.
setPluginRegistrantCallback is only needed for background-fired
scheduled notifications, which the app does not use.

Verified locally:
- flutter analyze lib test integration_test → no issues
- 238 notification-related tests green
  (test/services/notification_*, test/notifications/, test/widgets/notification_*,
   test/router/app_shell_notification_badge_test.dart)
- flutter build apk --debug → built successfully

* style: extract notification id local in sendLocal to match _sendPlatformNotification

The v20-migration commit landed `id:` as a wrapped multi-line expression
because the modulo arithmetic exceeded the line width. The sibling
`_sendPlatformNotification()` method on the same class already uses a
`notificationId` local with the same shape. Mirror that pattern in
`sendLocal()` so both call sites read identically and the
"Unique ID from timestamp" comment sits on the assignment rather than
buried mid-expression.

No behavior change; same modulo expression, same value.

* fix(notifications): align native setup with v21

* ci: retrigger checks

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
test(notifications): harden #4387 matrix with cubit + bloc convergence (#4562)

* test(notifications): harden #4387 matrix with cubit + bloc convergence

Closes the widget-level test gaps flagged in the #4387 regression
sweep matrix that don't require real-device push delivery (#4207).

notification_badge_cubit_auth_transition_test.dart
- Pins the BlocProvider/ValueKey wiring around the badge cubit: when
  notificationRepositoryProvider flips identity (signed-out -> signed
  -in, account switch A->B), the cubit is closed and recreated against
  the new repository, late emissions on the prior stream cannot reach
  the new cubit, and badge resets at 0 before B's stream pushes a
  value.

badge_converges_after_tap_read_back_test.dart
- Pins the "tap notification -> mark-as-read -> badge converges"
  contract. A shared BehaviorSubject feeds both watchSnapshot (bloc)
  and watchUnreadCount (cubit); tapping a row dispatches markAsRead
  through the bloc, the repository re-emits with the targeted item
  flagged read, and both consumers converge to the new unread count.
- Covers the no-double-decrement edge (tapping an already-read row
  leaves the badge unchanged) and the converges-to-zero terminal
  case.

Both tests run without any real-device or push infrastructure, so
#4387's manual QA surface shrinks to genuinely device-only items
(cold-start FCM delivery, OS permission UX, 200% font visual pass).

Towards epic #4200 close-out.

* test(notifications): remove badge convergence lint debt

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
chore(notifications): tighten badge a11y/theming and drop dead code (#4558)

* chore(notifications): tighten badge a11y/theming and drop dead code

- Replace inline TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: bold) with
  VineTheme.labelSmallFont() and Icon(Icons.circle) with a plain
  Container(BoxShape.circle) so the badge stops abusing the icon
  font for a geometric primitive (ui_theming.md).
- Wrap both badge variants in Semantics(label, container: true)
  reading the new pluralised notificationsBadgeUnread ARB key, so
  screen readers announce the unread count instead of just the
  child icon's label (accessibility.md).
- Isolate the AnimatedNotificationBadge pulse animation under a
  RepaintBoundary to avoid repainting the parent nav icon every
  animation frame (performance.md).
- Delete the unused filterRealtimeNotification helper on
  NotificationRepository (no callers in lib/, packages/, or test/).
  Realtime blocked-actor filtering still runs via acceptRealtime
  -> _enrichAndGroup -> _applyBlockFilter.
- Delete the legacy event_handlers_simple_test.dart file (a group
  level skip:true masked 6 already-skipped tests); the same
  behaviour is covered by notification_repository_test.dart after
  the WS bridge migration in #4288.

Notification subtree skipped-test count drops from 6 to 0. Toward
epic #4200 close-out.

* test(l10n): add notificationsBadgeUnread to known-untranslated-debt

The new ARB key shipped in the English source; non-English locales
fall back to English until the next translation pass — same pattern
as the rest of the notifications-redesign a11y keys
(notificationsViewProfileSemanticLabel etc.) sitting above it in
the debt set.

Unblocks the arb_consistency_test gate that was red on CI.

* fix(notifications): merge inbox badge semantics

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
refactor(notifications): make parseFcmPayload testable (#4563)

* refactor(notifications): make parseFcmPayload testable

Lift the previously-private _parseFcmPayload helper out of main.dart
into the existing notification_helpers.dart so it can be exercised by
unit tests directly. main.dart's two call sites now delegate to the
public parseFcmPayload, behaviour-identical.

The helper is the front-end of the cold-start push tap flow:
FirebaseMessaging.getInitialMessage() / onMessage -> parseFcmPayload
-> _resolveAndPushNotificationDeepLink. The downstream resolver still
lives in main.dart and is out of scope for this PR (push / deep-link
ownership sits with the push readiness and routing tracks).

Closes the previously-zero coverage on FCM payload parsing flagged
by #4387's matrix: returns-null guards (missing / empty
referencedEventId), wire-key normalisation ('type' -> notificationType),
no Nostr id truncation, and round-trips for every notification kind.

Towards epic #4200 close-out.

* fix(notifications): normalize parseFcmPayload keys

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>
